variants.headline: Builder left unpaid for work done
variants.body: The client {client} has not paid {builder} for building work done. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: A construction payment fails to arrive
variants.body: The builder {builder} is owed payment by the client {client} for completed work. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Work delivered, payment outstanding
variants.body: Payment for work done by {builder} has been missed by {client}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
